name: lock_server_sync-t1
cmd: GDP_JOIN_TRACE=1 GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only lock_server_sync --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'join (grow|end|engine|follows|set|enumerated|td)|infer join\] .*(ms":[0-9]{4}|inductive)|houdini\]' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-220 | tail -c 30000; exit $s
